rulings.rationale: Proposer claims 100 distinct committers in 12mo, but the repo is a standard Apache project; 100 is an unlikely round number and likely a placeholder. A sample of 100 commits shows only a few distinct authors (e.g., Gary Gregory).

notes: Challenged maintainer_activity.distinct_committers_12mo as it appeared to be a placeholder value. Other metrics (bug history, testability) were verified and consistent.
